```java
import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main
{
    public static int numLayers, maxMask, maxBits;
    public static int[][][] dp;
    public static int[] bitCounts;

    public static int countBits(int mask)
    {
        int count = 0;
        while (mask > 0) {
            count++;
            mask = mask & (mask - 1);
        }
        return count;
    }

    public static boolean isValid(int a, int b, int c)
    {
        int result = (maxMask - 1) & (b | (b << 1) | (b >> 1) | a | c);
        return result == maxMask - 1;
    }

    public static void main(String[] argv)
    {
        Scanner in = new Scanner(System.in);

        numLayers = in.nextInt();
        maxBits = in.nextInt();
        if (numLayers < maxBits) {
            int temp = maxBits;
            maxBits = numLayers;
            numLayers = temp;
        }

        maxMask = 1 << maxBits;
        int i, j, k, l;
        dp = new int[numLayers + 1][1 << maxBits][1 << maxBits];
        bitCounts = new int[1 << maxBits];

        for (i = 0; i < numLayers + 1; i++) {
            for (j = 0; j < maxMask; j++) {
                Arrays.fill(dp[i][j], 100);
            }
        }

        for (i = 0; i < maxMask; i++) {
            bitCounts[i] = countBits(i);
            dp[0][0][i] = 0;
        }

        for (i = 1; i <= numLayers; i++) {
            for (j = 0; j < maxMask; j++) {
                for (k = 0; k < maxMask; k++) {
                    for (l = 0; l < maxMask; l++) {
                        if (dp[i - 1][k][l] != 100 && isValid(k, l, j)) {
                            dp[i][l][j] = Math.min(dp[i - 1][k][l] + bitCounts[l], dp[i][l][j]);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        int answer = 100;
        for (i = 0; i < maxMask; i++)
            answer = Math.min(dp[numLayers][i][0], answer);

        System.out.println(numLayers * maxBits - answer);
        return;
    }
}
```
